note: SHA-256 of each asset this build expects, verified before the file is opened; a mismatch is an error, not a warning. Models are identified by file bytes. Atlases are identified by an ordered hash of their rows, to identify content independently of SQLite file layout; the Atlas wrapper may write metadata when initialized, whereas a read-only SQLite open does not inherently rewrite a file. 'url' is null until the assets are published alongside the tagged release. A download is verified against sha256 where the manifest records one and against content_fingerprint where it does not (atlases); an asset with neither is refused rather than installed unverified.

versions.note: The application and the model are versioned separately because they are separate artifacts. 0.5.x of this package ships the model trained under 0.4.6: the code moved, the estimators did not. A single number would have to misdescribe one of them, and the one it would misdescribe is the one that produces the numbers.

asset_provenance.summary: The model files recorded here are the artifacts present and verified on the release machine, not the ones the 0.4.8 manifest expected. Those were not found; the expectation is kept under each asset's 'supersedes' rather than deleted.
asset_provenance.identity_basis: Each substituted artifact was loaded in the environment named in 'built_with' (exact match on all five packages) and compared against docs/MODEL_CARD.md: 12 of 12 heads agree on headline metric and training-row count for the full model, and 12 of 12 agree with the ablation column for the sequence-only model -- 24 of 24 comparisons, no mismatches. Live predictions compute and the refusal paths return their reasons. This establishes agreement with the recorded model-card metadata; it does not uniquely establish artifact identity or fitted-estimator equivalence. It does not re-derive the metrics: that needs the 354 MB atlas and scripts/02_train.py, and the atlas is not present.
asset_provenance.what_was_not_established: That the superseded hashes describe a different model rather than a different save of this one. The payload is compressed, so the version stamp cannot be read from the raw bytes, and no file matching either superseded hash was found in the locations searched (C:\\Users, D:\\, E:\\, excluding system directories and archive interiors). Absence from those locations is not proof of non-existence.
